builds.name: Reference: Repeated on-hit
builds.goal: Reference for Vayne: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: A mobile single-target marksman who repeatedly attacks one target for Silver Bolts, using tumble and terrain knockback to preserve contact. Keep Silver Bolts on one target and record real Tumble/Condemn spacing. Extra bolts/phantom effects must be verified; true damage is not multiplied by armor penetration. Actual attacks can combine on-hit effects, attack speed and stacked defenses/penetration.
